project_title: Are we approaching the technological singularity?
central_question: Is there measurable evidence that AI development is becoming self-accelerating, and does it bear on the claim that a technological singularity is approaching?
initial_hypothesis: H1: some AI-capability/AI-production feedback loops may already be measurable, but their existence is not equivalent to a singularity.
epistemic_posture: map the evidence without choosing a side initially
deliverables: research artifacts (brief, registry, matrix, checkpoint, pass reports)

answers.central_question_posture: Map the evidence, pick no side
answers.audience_format: Technically curious general audience, ~15 min, as-of 2026-08-12, horizon 2035

defaults_used: 12-18 min narrated report video length band
